## What landed

**(1) `resume_set` producer (R-2.4.3).** `ViewKind::ResumeSet` is the
§5c.3 materialized view — a pure fold over the durable
`context.memory.written`/`invalidated` prefix: session-scope heads by
name in canonical order, a head dropped when its *latest* written
version is invalidated (`crates/hh-ledger/src/views.rs`;
`deriver = kernel`, restart-rebuildable to equal `view_hash`).
`Store::resume_set_heads` exposes the head-name list (names, not
version ids — the name history is the binding table). `continue_goal`
derives `carried.resume_set_heads` from the fold when the caller omits
the member, and honours an explicit `[]` as an empty resume set
(`crates/hh-embed/src/durability_ops.rs`). The `checkpoint` view payload
carries the derived `resume_set_heads[]` member — one fold, three
readers (CC1).

**(2) `defer` producer (R-2.8.7) — verified landed, no re-implementation.**
The dispatch ask path has minted
`wakeup_subscribe(Trigger::PermissionDecided{permission_id})` bound to
the durable `pending` row since S2.6 (`crates/hh-env/src/dispatch.rs`;
ADR-0268 D6), with `suspend(AwaitingApproval)` behind it; the resume
half is `decision_for_effect` in `authorize`. Evidence battery:
`ac_r_2_8_7_ask_emits_pending_then_suspends`,
`ac_r_2_8_7_respond_allow_resumes_and_executes`
(`hh-env/tests/acceptance.rs`).

**(3) Child-lease producers (R-2.6.3) — verified landed.** Spawn mints
`wakeup_subscribe(Trigger::ChildTerminal{child_run_id})` under the
parent lease at the real spawn path (`hh-subagent/src/spawn.rs`), and
child termination releases its `resource:*` locks from the real
terminal path — `o5_child_terminal_releases_resource_locks` (s4_8), the
`ac12_*` recovery legs (s4_6), s4_16b's spawn/reentry cells. This is
the substrate R3.3's `delegation_reason` legs consume (the ticket's
shared-decision note).

**(4) Non-fleet ingress-adapter producers (R-2.12.6).** The environment
binding declares ingress coverage:
`connection_info.ingress_adapters[]` validates at `open_session`
(entries need `source_ref` + `triggers ⊆ {external, manual}`; malformed
⇒ `SchemaViolation`) and stamps `manifest.extra.ingress_adapters`
(`crates/hh-embed/src/open.rs`). `wakeup_subscribe` then admits a
non-fleet `external`/`manual` subscription only where a declared entry
covers it (`ingress_declared` — `source_ref` exact-or-`"*"`, `manual`
kind-level); undeclared ⇒ typed `TriggerUnsupported` stage-4, fleet
`run_kind` behaviour unchanged (`crates/hh-ledger/src/wakeup.rs`).
`hh_fleet::observe_run` is the non-fleet producer half: each adapter
occurrence mints `context.observation.recorded` +
`control.wakeup.occurred` under the run's writer lease before
`deliver_wakeup` fires (CC3 durable-before-visible); replayed
occurrence ids hit the audited dedup `skipped` row; uncovered
occurrences record but never fire; fleet runs route back to
`FleetEngine::observe` (one producer per run kind — CC10)
(`crates/hh-fleet/src/engine.rs`).

**(5) `heal(env_handle)` surface (R-2.5.5).**
`EnvDriver::heal_handle(store, lease, env_handle_id)` is the
env-handle-level ladder the §5a.3 policy-level heal now composes over:
`suspended` → `resume`; `unreachable` + live session → `heal`'s
reattach rung; `unreachable` + dead channel with a recorded session →
`resume_helper` first (kernel death ≠ environment death);
unreachable/dead + `on_loss` → `replace_from_image`/
`replace_from_snapshot` (`Replaced{successor_env_handle_id}`, the
corpse terminal `replaced`) or `fail_run` → the durable
`action.environment.failed` row + `Failed`. States outside the ladder
(`ready`/`provisioning`/`detached`/`failed`/`replaced`) refuse typed
`InvalidState`. Every rung mints its `action.environment.*` row under
the writer lease before returning. The reattach live-check counts only
a real session in `self.sessions` — the local-host fallback stays a
verdict-measurement convenience, so a lost local-host workspace still
replaces rather than falsely reattaching (the
`r2_3_heal_lost_workspace_reprovisions_and_rebinds` invariant held)
(`crates/hh-env/src/recovery.rs`).

**(6) ADR-0265 re-check dated 2026-10-14.** The second revisit arm
fired — the R3.2 producers mint the same
`control.wakeup.{scheduled,occurred,fired}` rows under the run's fenced
writer and route through the same `deliver_wakeup` pass, so nothing
acquires a second fire path. **Answer recorded: D4 stands** — the
`(subscription_id, occurrence_key)` woken dedup stays the caller's
delivery-side set (a `fired` row surviving a crash correctly
re-delivers at-least-once; a durable `delivered` mark would still lose
a fired-never-delivered occurrence). D2/D7 quiet.

**Regression updates for the declaration gate.** Existing
external-subscription fixtures declare their adapter now:
`hh-ledger/tests/s4_13.rs`, `hh-embed/tests/conformance.rs`,
`hh-embed/tests/r2_3.rs` — the gate's typed refusal stays the
undeclared path, never a silent admit.
